data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports that prior closed years generally ran off satisfactorily in 2015 with most closed years contributing releases. There is no single quantified gross prior-year reserve movement disclosed; narrative indicates favourable development across older years (releases) driven by benign claims experience and run-off, though some commentary notes pockets of deterioration in old year reserves in the wider market. Specific named incidents mentioned in the report include MalaysianAirways Flight MH370 (reserve described as stable) and reference to Hurricane Sandy (2012) affecting US property market conditions.

with the possible exception of the loss from MalaysianAirways Flight MH370,the cause of which remains a mystery although the loss reserve is stable.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross (insurance liabilities) line labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' was found. The document contains P&L 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' rows (gross/net) which are NOT the required prior-year reserve movement and thus were not used. The report contains a loss-ratio development table (gross percentages) but not a gross cumulative claims triangle in absolute monetary terms per UW year, so a gross quantified PYD could not be computed. Narrative states that prior closed years contributed releases; therefore direction inferred as 'release' but no gross amount available. If a gross prior-year movement is required it is not disclosed in an appropriate gross movement note; only net or P&L-style figures and percentage triangles are provided.
